name: The Fixed Circle
generator: built-in image_gen.imagegen; existing local Node PNG/JPEG helper for bounded compositing and preview
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied ancestral square cave wall. Preserve every existing painting exactly: two ochre Pepe frogs, balance, branching paths, pouch and stones. Preserve original size 1254x1254, rock, roots, cracks, lighting, palette and framing. Add only a small primitive red-ochre closed oval enclosing three uneven charcoal pebble dabs on the empty rock at lower right, around x 835 to 1015 and y 680 to 825. This new mark symbolizes fixing a benchmark case set before a trial. Use worn thumb-dab pigment, rock showing through. Do not add any new figures, hands or handprints. Existing Pepes have wide mouths, heavy-lidded eyes and concealed hands. No letters, numbers, writing, captions, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, photographs, real people or political symbols. Save the edited actual PNG under artifacts/line-1/wall-v4.png in the current workspace if saving is supported. Do not save any other image in the workspace.

visual_review.method: Inspected finished full-resolution PNG and decoded 512-square JPEG using view_image. Compared with inherited wall.
visual_review.new_mark: A worn ochre closed ring contains three irregular charcoal stone dabs on formerly empty lower-right rock.
visual_review.pepe: Both ancestral cave Pepes retain wide mouths and heavy-lidded eyes.
visual_review.hands: Both ancestral figures have concealed hands. Zero visible hands or handprints; no visible digits to count. No new hands added.
visual_review.ancestry: Both Pepes, balance, branching paths, pouch and earlier stones are outside the changed patch and preserved exactly.
visual_review.rock_and_framing: Original square size, framing, roots, rock, cracks, torchlight and colors retained exactly outside the bounded patch.
visual_review.forbidden_content: No observed letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, real people, political or hateful symbols.
visual_review.limitations: Local visual judgment, not independent visual certification. Rock within the addition patch was generatively edited and blended; those bare-rock pixels are not identical to the predecessor.
